description: Catalog overlay of pipeline batch capital-one-refresh-2026-10: one entry per corpus card, merged from the overlay/<issuer>.json fragments by pipeline accept overlay.

anchors.quote: Accumulated T-Mobile Rewards may only be redeemed to pay your T-Mobile wireless bill or for purchases of phones, devices, or accessories

issues.note: Redemption values (travel formula, other options that vary) do not change what a purchase earns; miles keep no stated value per the issuer conventions.

rules.note: Grocery excludes superstores such as Walmart and Target (both brands excluded); third-party payment accounts and digital wallets may not get the higher rate, so paypal, venmo and digital-wallet are excluded.

issues.note: T-Mobile Rewards move to their own cash-back program redeemable only with T-Mobile.
The 5% rule excludes the digital-wallet path, so wallet checkouts count the 2% base rate.

hints.note: The 5% rule is scoped to T-Mobile and excludes digital wallets; the service and installment exclusions stay in the label text.
